stableFactsAndClaims: Anya sets the chessboard between two beds.
Her brother is asleep; she arranges his pieces and turns each knight toward the window.
A window cleaner lowers a wet brush outside; Anya watches it disappear before moving her pawn.
She waits with hands under her knees, leaving the next move to the empty pillow.
